title: Coordinates for ${\rm SL}_3$-web basis elements in closed surfaces
summary: The ${\rm SL}_3$-skein algebra of a closed surface $Σ_g$ is a quantization of the ${\rm SL}_3$ character variety of $Σ_g$, where $g$ denotes the genus of the surface. This algebra admits a basis consisting of non-elliptic web diagrams in $Σ_g$ after Sikora--Westbury. In this paper, we introduce explicit ${\rm SL}_3$ version of Dehn--Thurston coordinates for non-elliptic web diagrams on $Σ_g$, yielding a parametrization by a submonoid of $\mathbb Z^{d}$.
